title: Know safe cover and the approved route
objective: Prepare the learner to protect first and evacuate only after shaking.
ordered_actions: Identify a sturdy cover place.
Know the approved exit route and assembly area.
Practise the drill with an adult or teacher.
prohibited_actions: Do not choose a window, shelf, or doorway as the default cover place.
adult_handoff: A teacher or guardian confirms the safe cover, route, and assembly area.
rationale: Knowing the sequence before an earthquake reduces unsafe movement during shaking.
safe_default: Ask the teacher or guardian to show the approved cover and route.

en-PH.instruction: Find a sturdy cover place and learn the approved exit and assembly area with your teacher or guardian.

fil-PH.instruction: Kilalanin ang matibay na masisilungan at ang tamang labasan at assembly area kasama ang guro o tagapag-alaga.

taglish-PH.instruction: Alamin ang sturdy cover, approved exit, at assembly area kasama ang teacher o guardian.

title: Recognize outdoor earthquake hazards
objective: Help the learner recognize a safer open area before shaking.
ordered_actions: Identify the scenario-approved open area.
Notice buildings, trees, posts, power lines, and glass that may fall.
prohibited_actions: Do not select a spot beside a wall, tree, post, or power line.
adult_handoff: A teacher or guardian confirms the outdoor safe area.
rationale: Outdoor falling and electrical hazards must be recognized before a drill.
safe_default: Ask an adult to identify the approved open area.

en-PH.instruction: Choose the approved open area away from buildings, trees, posts, power lines, and glass.

fil-PH.short: Hanapin ang ligtas na bukas na lugar.
fil-PH.instruction: Piliin ang itinakdang bukas na lugar na malayo sa gusali, puno, poste, linya ng kuryente, at salamin.

taglish-PH.instruction: Piliin ang approved open area na malayo sa buildings, trees, posts, power lines, at glass.

title: Tell an adult about an unsafe object
objective: Let the learner identify hazards without moving or repairing them.
ordered_actions: Move away from the unsafe object.
Tell a teacher or guardian what and where it is.
prohibited_actions: Do not climb, lift, tie, repair, or move heavy furniture or hanging objects.
adult_handoff: An adult or professional secures the object.
rationale: Hazard recognition is age-appropriate; repair and lifting are not.
safe_default: Keep your distance and tell an adult.

en-PH.short: Step away and tell an adult.
en-PH.instruction: Do not move the heavy or hanging object. Tell your teacher or guardian where it is.

fil-PH.instruction: Huwag galawin ang mabigat o nakasabit na bagay. Sabihin sa guro o tagapag-alaga kung nasaan ito.

taglish-PH.short: Step away and tell an adult.
taglish-PH.instruction: Huwag galawin ang heavy o hanging object. Sabihin sa teacher o guardian kung nasaan ito.

title: Drop Cover and Hold On indoors
objective: Protect the learner's head and body until shaking stops.
ordered_actions: Drop to hands and knees.
Take cover under the sturdy desk or table.
Hold on and protect the head and neck.
Stay there until shaking stops.
prohibited_actions: Do not run to an exit while shaking continues.
Do not use an elevator.
adult_handoff: After shaking stops follow the teacher or guardian's evacuation instruction.
rationale: The learner needs an immediate protective action rather than generative advice.

en-PH.instruction: Stay under the sturdy desk and protect your head and neck until the shaking stops.

fil-PH.instruction: Manatili sa ilalim ng matibay na mesa at protektahan ang ulo at leeg hanggang tumigil ang pagyanig.

taglish-PH.instruction: Stay under the sturdy desk at protektahan ang head and neck hanggang huminto ang shaking.

title: Stay away from glass and falling objects
objective: Keep the learner away from objects likely to break or fall.
ordered_actions: Stay low.
Move only the short safe distance needed to use the approved cover.
Protect the head and neck.
prohibited_actions: Do not stand beside windows, cabinets, shelves, or hanging objects.
Do not cross the room unless the approved route is safe.
adult_handoff: Follow the teacher or guardian after shaking.
rationale: Glass and unsecured objects can cause injury during shaking.
safe_default: Protect the head and use the nearest approved cover.

en-PH.short: Stay away from glass and shelves.
en-PH.instruction: Stay low, protect your head, and use the nearest approved cover without crossing an unsafe area.

fil-PH.instruction: Manatiling mababa, protektahan ang ulo, at sumilong sa pinakamalapit na ligtas na puwesto nang hindi dumaraan sa panganib.

taglish-PH.short: Stay away from glass and shelves.
taglish-PH.instruction: Stay low, protect your head, at gamitin ang nearest approved cover nang hindi dumadaan sa unsafe area.

title: Do not evacuate while shaking
objective: Stop unsafe evacuation while strong shaking is active.
ordered_actions: Stop moving toward the exit.
Use the nearest approved cover.
Wait until shaking stops.
prohibited_actions: Do not run outside during shaking.
Do not push or use an elevator.
adult_handoff: Evacuate only after shaking stops and the teacher or guardian directs it.
rationale: Evacuation during shaking increases exposure to falling objects and crowd injury.
safe_default: Protect in place until shaking stops.

en-PH.short: Do not run outside while it is shaking.
en-PH.instruction: Stop, use the nearest approved cover, and wait until the shaking stops.

fil-PH.instruction: Huminto, sumilong sa pinakamalapit na ligtas na puwesto, at hintaying tumigil ang pagyanig.

taglish-PH.short: Do not run outside habang umuuga.
taglish-PH.instruction: Stop, use the nearest approved cover, at hintaying huminto ang shaking.

title: Stay clear of outdoor falling hazards
objective: Keep an outdoor learner away from structures and overhead hazards.
ordered_actions: Stay outside.
Protect the head and neck.
If the short route is safe move to the approved open area.
Remain there until shaking stops.
prohibited_actions: Do not enter a building.
Do not stand beside walls, trees, posts, power lines, or glass.
adult_handoff: After shaking follow the responsible adult's instruction.
rationale: Outdoor learners need a location-specific action rather than an indoor cover command.
safe_default: Stay clear of structures and protect the head.

en-PH.short: Stay outside and away from falling hazards.
en-PH.instruction: Protect your head and move only if the short route to the approved open area is safe.

fil-PH.short: Manatili sa labas at lumayo sa maaaring bumagsak.
fil-PH.instruction: Protektahan ang ulo at gumalaw lamang kung ligtas ang maikling daan papunta sa itinakdang bukas na lugar.

taglish-PH.short: Stay outside and away from falling hazards.
taglish-PH.instruction: Protect your head at move only kung safe ang short route papunta sa approved open area.

title: Evacuate school after shaking stops
objective: Move the learner from class to the approved assembly area in order.
ordered_actions: Listen to the teacher.
Walk through the approved exit route.
Use stairs if needed.
Go to the assigned assembly area and stay with the class.
prohibited_actions: Do not run, push, use an elevator, or retrieve belongings.
Do not leave the assembly group.
adult_handoff: The teacher leads evacuation and headcount.
rationale: The school drill sequence separates protection during shaking from evacuation afterward.
safe_default: Stay with the teacher and follow the approved route.

en-PH.short: Walk with your teacher to the assembly area.
en-PH.instruction: Use the approved route, do not run or push, and stay with your class for headcount.

fil-PH.short: Maglakad kasama ang guro papunta sa assembly area.
fil-PH.instruction: Sundin ang tamang daan, huwag tumakbo o manulak, at manatili sa klase para sa bilang.

taglish-PH.short: Walk with your teacher to the assembly area.
taglish-PH.instruction: Follow the approved route, huwag tumakbo o manulak, at stay with your class for headcount.

title: Follow the guardian after home shaking
objective: Let the responsible adult lead the home evacuation.
ordered_actions: Listen to the guardian.
Use the approved safe route.
Walk to the family meeting place and stay together.
prohibited_actions: Do not retrieve belongings.
Do not touch utilities or damaged objects.
adult_handoff: The guardian decides the route and handles utilities.
rationale: A child should not assess structural or utility safety.
safe_default: Stay with the guardian in the safest available area.

en-PH.instruction: Follow the approved safe route to the family meeting place and do not touch damaged objects or utilities.

fil-PH.instruction: Sundin ang ligtas na daan papunta sa meeting place at huwag hawakan ang sirang bagay o kagamitan sa kuryente at gas.

taglish-PH.instruction: Follow the approved safe route papunta sa family meeting place at huwag hawakan ang damaged objects o utilities.

title: Remain clear of outdoor hazards after shaking
objective: Keep the learner in an open safe area after an earthquake.
ordered_actions: Stay in the approved open area.
Look out for debris and damaged lines from a distance.
Wait for the responsible adult.
prohibited_actions: Do not approach damaged buildings, fallen lines, trees, bridges, or debris.
Do not enter a building.
adult_handoff: An adult or responder gives the next movement instruction.
rationale: Aftershocks and hidden damage can make nearby structures unsafe.
safe_default: Remain in the approved open area.

en-PH.short: Stay in the open safe area.
en-PH.instruction: Keep away from damaged buildings, debris, trees, bridges, and power lines while waiting for an adult.

fil-PH.short: Manatili sa ligtas na bukas na lugar.
fil-PH.instruction: Lumayo sa sirang gusali, debris, puno, tulay, at linya ng kuryente habang naghihintay sa nakatatanda.

taglish-PH.short: Stay in the open safe area.
taglish-PH.instruction: Keep away from damaged buildings, debris, trees, bridges, at power lines habang naghihintay sa adult.

title: Do not enter a damaged structure
ordered_actions: Stay outside in the approved safe area.
Tell an adult why you wanted to return.
Wait for official clearance.
prohibited_actions: Do not enter for belongings, pets, or another person.
Do not inspect the damage.
adult_handoff: A responder or qualified authority clears re-entry.
rationale: A damaged building can fail during an aftershock.
safe_default: Stay outside and wait for clearance.

en-PH.instruction: Stay in the safe area and wait until a responsible authority says the building is safe.

fil-PH.instruction: Manatili sa ligtas na lugar at hintayin ang abiso ng kinauukulan na ligtas ang gusali.

taglish-PH.instruction: Stay sa safe area at hintayin ang authority na sabihing safe na ang building.

source_claims.locator: Current PHIVOLCS primer section on affected communities

title: Report injury or a missing person
objective: Get trained adult help without assigning rescue or treatment to the learner.
ordered_actions: Tell the nearest teacher, guardian, or responder.
State who needs help and the last safe location known.
Remain in the safe area.
prohibited_actions: Do not enter a damaged area to rescue someone.
Do not give medicine or unapproved treatment.
adult_handoff: A trained adult or responder handles search and care.
rationale: Clear reporting is useful and age-appropriate; rescue and treatment are not.
safe_default: Tell a responsible adult and remain safe.

en-PH.short: Tell an adult who needs help.
en-PH.instruction: Give the teacher, guardian, or responder the person's name and last safe location, then stay in the safe area.

fil-PH.short: Sabihin sa nakatatanda kung sino ang nangangailangan ng tulong.
fil-PH.instruction: Ibigay sa guro, tagapag-alaga, o responder ang pangalan at huling ligtas na lugar ng tao, saka manatili sa safe area.

taglish-PH.short: Tell an adult who needs help.
taglish-PH.instruction: Sabihin sa teacher, guardian, o responder ang name at last safe location, then stay sa safe area.

title: Protect again when an aftershock starts
objective: Return the learner to the approved protective action for the current location.
ordered_actions: Stop moving.
Use the approved protective action for the current indoor or outdoor zone.
Wait until the aftershock stops.
prohibited_actions: Do not run into or out of a building during the aftershock.
adult_handoff: After it stops follow the responsible adult's instruction.
rationale: An aftershock changes the current state back to active shaking.
safe_default: Stop and protect in the current approved zone.

en-PH.instruction: Use the approved protective action for where you are and wait until the shaking stops.

fil-PH.short: Aftershock—huminto at protektahan muli ang sarili.
fil-PH.instruction: Gawin ang tamang protective action para sa iyong kinaroroonan at hintaying tumigil ang pagyanig.

taglish-PH.instruction: Use the approved protective action for your current zone at hintaying huminto ang shaking.

title: Wait for the school's evacuation instruction
objective: Keep the learner with the class until the school starts the approved evacuation procedure.
ordered_actions: Stay with the teacher and class.
Wait for the school's evacuation instruction.
Move only when the teacher gives the approved route.
prohibited_actions: Do not choose your own exit or assembly area.
Do not run, push, or retrieve belongings.
adult_handoff: The teacher or designated school staff starts evacuation and identifies the approved route.
rationale: School-specific alarm meanings and routes must come from the reviewed deployment plan, not from CALM's inference.
safe_default: Stay with the teacher and wait for the approved school instruction.

en-PH.short: Stay with your teacher and wait.
en-PH.instruction: Do not choose your own exit. Move only when your teacher gives the approved route.

fil-PH.instruction: Huwag pumili ng sariling labasan. Gumalaw lamang kapag ibinigay ng guro ang tamang ruta.

taglish-PH.short: Stay with your teacher and wait.
taglish-PH.instruction: Huwag pumili ng sariling exit. Move only kapag ibinigay ng teacher ang approved route.

title: Stay for the school assembly headcount
objective: Keep the learner in the assigned group so school staff can account for everyone.
ordered_actions: Stay in the assigned assembly area with the class.
Answer when the teacher checks attendance.
Tell the teacher about an injury or missing classmate.
Wait for the next school instruction.
prohibited_actions: Do not leave the assembly group.
Do not go back into a building or search for someone.
adult_handoff: School staff conduct the headcount and begin the school's controlled release procedure when authorized.
rationale: Assembly is for immediate accountability after evacuation; it is separate from reunification with an authorized adult.
safe_default: Stay with the class in the assigned assembly area.

en-PH.short: Stay with your class for headcount.
en-PH.instruction: Answer your teacher, report anyone who may need help, and wait in the assigned assembly area.

fil-PH.short: Manatili sa klase para sa bilang.
fil-PH.instruction: Sumagot sa guro, iulat kung may nangangailangan ng tulong, at maghintay sa itinakdang assembly area.

taglish-PH.short: Stay with your class for headcount.
taglish-PH.instruction: Answer your teacher, i-report kung may need ng help, at wait sa assigned assembly area.
